# Yassine El Ouazzani

> Mobile App & Full Stack Developer from Meknès, Morocco.

## Bio
Yassine El Ouazzani is a software developer specializing in native Android development (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, MVVM), cross-platform mobile applications (Flutter, Dart), and full-stack web applications. Digital Development graduate from OFPPT - ISTAG BAB TIZIMI with a background in Physical Sciences.

## Core Competencies
- Mobile: Native Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, MVVM, Material You), Flutter, Dart, Riverpod
- Web: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Node.js, PHP, MySQL, Responsive Design
- Backend & Automation: Go (Gin, PostgreSQL, Redis), Python, Selenium, BeautifulSoup, Web Scraping
- Developer Tools: Git, GitHub, VS Code, Android Studio, IntelliJ IDEA, Postman, Linux

## Featured Projects
- Sentinel - Dead Man's Switch: High-reliability personal safety companion featuring a Go backend API (Gin, PostgreSQL, Redis) and a Flutter mobile client with OTP authentication and background GPS tracking.
  - Backend: https://github.com/Yass5002/sentinel-core-api
  - Frontend: https://github.com/Yass5002/sentinel
- AL AMAL Medical Laboratory: Professional medical laboratory web platform with service catalog, home sampling booking, and insurer integrations.
  - Live: https://laboratoirealamal.me/
  - GitHub: https://github.com/Yass5002/MohamedYakhlif.github.io
- ORA - Countdown Timer App: Modern, privacy-focused open-source Android countdown timer app with Material You widgets and theme-aware pulsing neon UI.
  - GitHub: https://github.com/Yass5002/Ora
